% !TeX program = pdflatex
%%% Default header and footer layout: chapter left and section right in the header, title and page number in the footer.
\documentclass[phd,12pt,a4paper]{bangorthesis}
\title{A Reasonably Sized Thesis Title}
\author{T. Student}
\degreescheme{Doctor of Philosophy}
\newcommand{\filler}{Body text that fills the page so that the chapter runs across several pages and the running header shows on the continuation pages.}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand{\fillpages}{m}{\prg_replicate:nn{#1}{\filler\par}}
\ExplSyntaxOff

\begin{document}
\maketitle
\chapter{Introduction}
\section{First section}
\fillpages{30}
\section{Second section}
\fillpages{30}
\chapter{Methods}
\section{Only section}
\fillpages{20}
\end{document}
